description: Extend existing MattermostAdmin /api/v4/users/me identity fetch (currently fetch_bot_user_id/2) to return ID and username, wire ChannelsLive Fetch Identity adjacent to Bot Token, and make identity inputs readonly. Action reuse assessment: extend existing MattermostAdmin admin-only operation, no new Action or agent tool; inputs instance URL and token, outputs {:ok, %{id, username}} or {:error, reason}, no writes/retry concerns; BO calls existing local admin helper (existing pattern), explicit Save persists settings via ChannelConfig and NodeRouter runtime sync. Verify HTTP valid/malformed/error and LiveView missing URL/token, populated readonly fields and error; no feature E2E needed for narrow adjustment already covered at LiveView level. Review existing tests before implementation.
title: Fetch and lock Mattermost bot identity from token
